question: Who among the following was the first Indian athlete to win an Olympic gold medal?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Abhinav Bindra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Abhinav Bindra** became the first Indian athlete to win an individual **Olympic gold medal** at the **2008 Beijing Olympics**.
 
• He won the gold medal in the **10m Air Rifle shooting event**, creating history for India.
 
• Abhinav Bindra is known for his **consistent performances** and dedication to the sport of shooting.
 
• He has also received several prestigious awards, including the **Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna**, India’s highest sporting honor, and the **Padma Bhushan**, India’s third-highest civilian award.
 
• Bindra is widely regarded as a pioneer in Indian shooting and has inspired numerous young athletes in the country to pursue the sport.
 
• His gold medal victory was a landmark achievement in Indian sports history, marking a turning point for the nation in the international sports arena.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Milkha Singh**__

 __
 
• **Milkha Singh**, popularly known as the **‘Flying Sikh’**, was an Indian track and field athlete.
 
• He represented India in the **1956, 1960, and 1964 Olympics**, excelling in sprinting events.
 
• While Milkha Singh achieved great success in athletics, he did not win an Olympic medal but remains an iconic figure in Indian sports history.
 
 
 
• **Neeraj Chopra**__
 __
 
• **Neeraj Chopra** is an Indian javelin thrower who won a **gold medal** at the **2020 Tokyo Olympics**.
 
• He became the **first Indian athlete to win an Olympic gold medal in athletics**.
 
• His achievement further solidified India’s status in global sports.
 
 
 
• **KD Jadhav**__
 
 
• **Khashaba Dadasaheb Jadhav (KD Jadhav)** was the first Indian to win an individual Olympic medal.
 
• He won a **bronze medal in wrestling** at the **1952 Helsinki Olympics**.
 
• Despite his achievement, he did not win a gold medal.
